adjudication.rationale: The diff adds nontrivial feed-parsing/import logic in `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (SimpleRSS.parse, per-item URL fallback, `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`, and `TopicEmbed.import(...)`), but the new spec `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb` only tests guard conditions in `execute` and that it delegates to `poll_feed`; it does not exercise `poll_feed` itself. The code also assumes `i.content` is always a String (`i.content.scrub`), with no nil handling, so a nil `content` value would raise and stop the job (and `sidekiq_options retry: false` means it won’t be retried). Whether specific feeds yield nil `i.content` depends on SimpleRSS/feed structure, so the failure scenario is plausible but not fully provable from the diff alone.
